author: mikeyk
text: Love what the @warpdotdev team is building — snappy, modern terminal with some really nice AI-powered features.

quoted.text:
Warp is bringing collaboration to the command line. 

The modern, Rust-based terminal with AI built in is now available for teams. With Warp Drive you can save and share your team’s commands right inside your terminal. 

Learn more about Warp Drive (and our $50M Series B!) 👇 https://t.co/vTJ3JSaogz

author: mikeyk
text:
Today we're adding the ability to comment on articles on @ARTIFACT_News. Update your app in the App or Play Store to try it out.

Articles also now get a full-screen treatment once you start scrolling. Looking forward to hearing what you think! https://t.co/qbZq4LkR9R
